generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: replacement 4x4 walk-animation pixel-art atlas for this reference Lia travel outfit. Preserve Lia's copper-red long curly hair held back with narrow band, small white blouse, plain brown calf-length skirt, brown leather shoes, satchel and rolled wool blanket. Both hands free. This is an animation task: CHANGE LEG POSES substantially, do not repeat the same legs. Reference defines appearance only; the existing fixed leg poses are WRONG.
EXACTLY 4 rows and 4 columns of whole-body sprites, uniform grid, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Rows in order: SOUTH front, WEST left profile, EAST right profile, NORTH back. Columns are exact four-frame walk cycle: 1 left leg forward contact, right foot back; 2 passing phase feet close together with right foot visibly lifting; 3 right leg forward contact, left foot back; 4 opposite passing phase feet close, left foot lifting. Row south: column 1 viewer-right shoe lower and viewer-left shoe higher, column 3 viewer-left shoe lower and viewer-right shoe higher. Row north opposite anatomical feet; two shoes always separated horizontally and visible. Side rows: contact phases shoes widely separated and one knee bent, passing phases shoes near each other vertically, so foot silhouettes alternate wide/narrow/wide/narrow. ALL FOUR ROWS have genuine cyclic foot motion; every frame shows TWO distinct shoes. Skirt hem high enough to show calves and shoes, no single central foot. Head position and torso heights remain stable within each row, no fake whole-body bob. Arms swing with gait. Same face, hair and outfit in every frame. Crisp chunky low-resolution pixel art; game scale roughly37px tall per sprite, avoid finely shaded high-res illustration. Generous clear cell gutters, no text, no frame borders, no terrain, no ground shadows. Front and back stride clearly alternate feet horizontally, not an unchanged single foot centered under skirt.
